new_findings.title: fiscal_dated_at NOT stamped on the kiosk-paid fiscal-allocation path (finalizePaidKioskOrder) — deferred kiosk allocation across a Z reopens the exact P1 gap AND evades the honest detector
new_findings.proof: Enumerated ALL 6 fiscal_sequence_no allocation sites. 3 stamp fiscal_dated_at (PaymentService:338/346 confirmCounterPayment; OrderService:1997/2005 delivery COD; OrderService:2603/2609 marquer-paye). 1 refund mirror is fresh-created (created_at=alloc, safe). 1 synchronous POS create (OrderService:1181, non-deferred, created_at=alloc). The 6th — FrontendOrderService::finalizePaidKioskOrder:1238 (`$locked->fiscal_sequence_no = $newSeq;`) — does NOT stamp fiscal_dated_at (b05ba62c5/0fcad5985 did not touch this file; git log 24e8a09c3..HEAD on FrontendOrderService.php shows no fiscal_dated_at change). This path is reached DEFERRED via (a) RetryFiscalAllocCommand (schedule everyMinute, picks PAID+fiscal NULL+fiscal_alloc_error_at oldest-first, re-invokes finalize) and (b) PaymentReconcileController:265 (late webhook/poll). Repro (logic): kiosk order created T0 in Z_n, alloc FAILS -> fiscal_alloc_error_at set; Z_n closes (order excluded, fiscal NULL); retry cron in Z_{n+1} allocates fiscal_sequence_no with fiscal_dated_at NULL -> COALESCE=created_at=T0 <= from(Z_n.closed_at) -> EXCLUDED from Z_{n+1} positive window -> numbered receipt in ZERO signed Z = NF525 gap-free violation. Worse, it is INVISIBLE to fiscal:verify-z-membership: fiscalDate=created_at=T0 falls inside Z_n's (already-closed) post-C33 window -> detector says 'sealed in Z_n -> OK' (false negative), though Z_n's signed aggregate excluded it. The LOCK plan (plans/LOCK_ZREPORT_FISCAL_C33_DELIVERY_VAT_2026-07-07.md) contains NO mention of finalizePaidKioskOrder / retry-alloc / kiosk auto-alloc — path was outside considered scope. Reachability bounded by (alloc-failure OR delayed-reconcile) AND (allocation spanning a Z close); low but non-zero (the retry mechanism exists precisely because alloc DOES fail — iter13/iter14 orphan history). Answers the task's targeted question: fiscal_dated_at is NOT on ALL allocation paths — one is forgotten. NOTE: fix is attack-only-reported; NOT modified per supervisor mandate.
